myInqPrep: Uma indawo isixhunyiwe, uzokwazi ukubona imiyalezo yakho ethunyelwe kanye nezimpendulo lapha.
r1c: Thepha iphuzu elingenalutho ukuze ubeke ucezu. Okumnyama nokumhlophe kuyashintshana ngokubeka kuze kube yilapho zonke izingcezu sezisebhodini. Okumnyama kuhamba kuqala.
r1c2: Indlela yokudlala: vele uthephe indawo engenalutho lapho umcibisholo omhlophe uya khona.
r2t: ② Hlela ezintathu ngokulandelana: umshini wokugaya
r2c: Uma ezintathu zezingcezu zakho zilandelana emgqeni, lokho kuyimishini yokugaya, futhi ungathatha enye yezingcezu zomphikisi wakho.
r2c2: Indlela yokudlala: ngemva kokwakha umshini wokugaya, thepha ingxenye yomphikisi ofuna ukuyithatha.
r2c3: Ingxenye engaphakathi komshini wokugaya ayikwazi ukuthathwa, ngaphandle kokuthi zonke izingcezu zomphikisi wakho zisemishini yokugaya; khona-ke ungathatha eyodwa kusuka kumshini wokugaya.
r3c: Uma zonke izingcezu sezibekwe, slayida ucezu emgqeni uye endaweni engenalutho eseduze. Izingcezu ezingahamba zithola indandatho enombala ogqamile ngemuva. Thepha ucezu bese izindawo eziya kuzo zikhanya.
r3c2: Indlela yokudlala: thepha ucezu ofuna ukuluhambisa, bese uthinta indawo eseduze ekhanyayo.
r4c: Uma usele nezingcezu ezintathu kuphela, ungandiza uye kunoma iyiphi indawo engenalutho, noma ngabe akukho mugqa ozixhumanisayo.
r4c2: Indlela yokudlala: thepha ucezu lwakho, bese uthinta indawo engenalutho ofuna ukundiza kuyo.
r5c: Uyanqoba ngokunciphisa umphikisi wakho abe yizingcezu ezimbili, noma ngokumshiya engenaso isinyathelo esisemthethweni.
r6c: Umdlali ngamunye unezingcezu ezingu-12 futhi kunezelwa imigqa emine evundlile. Ungahamba ngokuvundlile, kanti ezintathu zilandelana ku-vundlile nazo zakha umshini wokugaya.
r6c2: Indlela yokudlala: ukunyakaza okuvundlile kusebenza ngendlela efanayo — thepha ucezu, bese kuba iphuzu lokuya khona.
r6c3: Uma ibhodi ligcwalisa ngokuphelele ngesikhathi sesigaba sokubeka, umdlali ozohamba ngeke akwazi ukuhamba futhi alahlekelwe.
r7c: Umdlalo udwetshwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kunoma yiziphi izimo ezingezansi. Ayikho inkinobho yokunikeza ukudweba.
r7c2: · Indawo efanayo ebhodini enomdlali ofanayo wokunyakaza yenzeka kathathu
r7c3: · Izinyathelo ezingu-50 (bobabili abadlali behlangene) zidlula ngaphandle kwesigayo
r7c4: · Inguqulo yezingcezu ezingu-12 kuphela: ngenkathi umdlali enezingcezu ezintathu, izinyathelo ezingu-10 (ezihlanganisiwe) zidlula ngaphandle komuntu obambayo
r8c: Ngisho noma ukunyakaza okukodwa kwakha izigayo ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa, usathatha ucezu olulodwa kuphela.
r8c2: Inguqulo yezingcezu ezingu-9: ungase uphule isigayo bese usivala futhi ekunyakazeni kwakho okulandelayo; isikhathi ngasinye lapho usivala, uthatha ucezu.
r8c3: Inguqulo yezingcezu ezingu-12: isigayo osiphule asikwazi ukwenziwa kabusha ekunyakazeni kwakho okulandelayo; linda ukunyakaza okukodwa. Izinyathelo ezingakhi isigayo zilungile.
r8c4: Imidlalo eku-inthanethi inezinyathelo ezintathu: Okujwayelekile yimizuzwana engu-30 ngokunyakaza ngakunye, Ukuhamba kancane yimizuzu emi-2, kanye neNcwadi amahora angu-24. Emidlalweni ye-Slow and Letter, ukunyakaza kudlalwa ngokuzenzakalelayo uma isikhathi siphela.

titlesPrep: Izihloko zizovela uma iseva eku-inthanethi isixhunyiwe. Amagama nemibandela yezihloko ozitholayo zizoboniswa njengoba iseva izibuyisela. Azikakulungeli okwamanje.
